falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 80% bottom_2024_aug pattern match would be invalidated because that pattern held above 4,800 throughout its formation; a break below this level proves the structural support assumed in the pattern has failed, making the 'bottom' call incorrect

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX elevation above 25 directly contradicts the low blowoff score of 39, which implies complacency/weak selling pressure; persistent fear invalidates the thesis that this is a calm bottoming environment rather than the start of a volatility expansion phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year Treasury yield rises above 4.50% and holds there for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would break the rate stabilization assumption embedded in the bottom_2024_aug pattern, where yields peaked and declined; renewed rate pressure would prove the macro conditions supporting the bottom call have deteriorated, invalidating the UNKNOWN/HOLD verdict as a valid bottom formation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
